About pronunciation

German audio is sourced from Wiktionary and Wikimedia Commons. Recordings are community-contributed; availability, accent and native-speaker status vary. Missing recordings stop playback so you can skip the word. Noun recordings usually pronounce the noun without its article.

Arabic uses a voice installed on your device, not a human recording. Egyptian pronunciation depends on the available voice. Words without an Arabic translation are excluded from German–Arabic playlists. Keep this page open during playback.
